text:
Priya: quick question — who can own the safe-defaults toggle flip tonight (20:00 PT)? need a single deploy owner + one smoke checker.
Luca: I can take deploy owner if nobody else is oncall for platform ops at that time.
Sam: I can do smoke checks right after, + keep an eye on latency dashboards. what slice are we opening?
Priya: thanks Luca. plan is to enable safe-defaults for eu/na tenants only (20% routing) for the first 30m, then evaluate.
Jared: can you paste the exact flag key and the command you'll run? want to add to our runbook.
Priya: flag is `service.feature.safe_defaults_v3`. we'll use the config-service toggle endpoint: 
```
curl -X POST https://config.redwood.internal/flags/safe_defaults_v3/activate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"scope":"region","regions":["eu","na"],"percent":20}'
```
Luca: perfect. rollback command: 
```
curl -X POST https://config.redwood.internal/flags/safe_defaults_v3/deactivate -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN"
```
Anya: adding two quick smoke checks: 1) run `make smoke` against staging proxies pointed at canary, 2) check token-level cost in console for any sudden spikes.
Sam: for observability — I'll monitor p50/p95 latency, error rate, and the per-route token cost panel. will post screenshots if anything looks off.
Priya: can someone own rollback readiness (i.e., have creds + quick access to run the curl)?
Jared: I have creds and can be on standby for rollback.
Luca: noted. I'll perform the flip and watch infra logs. if CPU or GPU queue grows >15% we'll roll back immediately.
deploy-bot: scheduled toggle job created by Luca for 2024-11-02T20:00:00-07:00 — job id jb-88f2. (Use /deploy status jb-88f2) :rocket:
Sam: can we add a short post-flip checklist to the thread so QA knows what to run?
Priya: yes — 1) sanity prompt set through chatflow; 2) embeddings consistency check with sample corpus; 3) run 5 long-sequence generation requests to confirm KV cache behavior.
Anya: FYI: tagging the rollout as "safe-defaults-v3-evening-slice" in the console so we can query metrics later.
Jared: ok I'm on rollback standby from 19:55-20:30 PT. ping me in this thread if you flip.
Luca: will ping right before flip and immediately after. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Priya: sweet — I'll update the runbook and post the final confirmation 30m prior.
Sam: thanks team. I'll post snapshots at +5m, +15m, +30m.
Priya: closing this thread until preflip. feel free to leave any last checks here.
